component-o.description-s: 10A fully-integrated synchronous boost converter, 2.7-12V in, adjustable output (configured 7.0V) [PFM SKU: MODE (pin 13) left open: PFM at light load. Best light-load efficiency; the switching frequency varies at light load (audible noise possible).]

cfgpins-ao.2c: EN: logic high turns the converter on. Tied to VIN for always-on (Figure 8-1 shows an ON/OFF switch); a GPIO may drive it instead.

cfgpins-ao.17c: Feedback divider (Figure 8-1, 3.3 V to 9 V/3 A): R1 360 kΩ VOUT to FB, R2 56 kΩ FB to ground (the datasheet's standard low-side value); VOUT = VREF x (1 + R1/R2), VREF 1.204 V (PWM) / 1.212 V (PFM). The design re-values it to the architect's set-point.

cfgpins-ao.3c: Switching frequency set by a resistor from FSW to SW (not to ground): 255 kΩ gives the typical application's 600 kHz.

cfgpins-ao.19c: Peak switch current limit: resistor ILIM to AGND; 100 kΩ gives about 11.9 A (datasheet, Setting Peak Current Limit).

cfgpins-ao.18c: Loop compensation R5 + C5 from COMP to AGND, computed with the datasheet equations for Figure 8-1 (3.3 V to 9 V/3 A, L 1.2 µH, CO 67 µF, fC 10 kHz below fRHPZ/5): R5 = 2π·VOUT·Rsense·fC·CO / ((1-D)·VREF·GEA) = 36.5 kΩ (Rsense 0.08 Ω, GEA 190 µA/V); C5 = RO·CO / (2·R5) = 2.7 nF. C8 = RESR·CO / R5 is about 4 pF with ceramic output capacitors: not fitted.

cfgpins-ao.13c: MODE left open (not connected): PFM at light load, per the datasheet (floating = PFM). Intentionally unstrapped.

component-o.sku-note-s: MODE (pin 13) left open: PFM at light load. Best light-load efficiency; the switching frequency varies at light load (audible noise possible).
